sql: SELECT current.state.reported AS actual, previous.state.reported AS anterior, topic(3) AS thingName, timestamp() AS ts FROM '$aws/things/+/shadow/update/documents' WHERE previous.state.reported.posicion <> current.state.reported.posicion OR previous.state.reported.agua_detectada <> current.state.reported.agua_detectada OR previous.state.reported.modo <> current.state.reported.modo OR previous.state.reported.led <> current.state.reported.led OR previous.state.reported.oscuro <> current.state.reported.oscuro
